statBlock.name: Shoosuva
statBlock.description: Yeenoghu sends this hyena-like demon to fight alongside an especially powerful gnoll. Its venomous tail can immobilize creatures for the war band to finish.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage. When the shoosuva reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its own turn, it can move up to half its speed and make one Bite attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail Stinger attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (4d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Tail Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. The creature is also paralyzed while poisoned this way. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

statBlock.name: Slithering Tracker
statBlock.description: A creature driven by revenge can undergo a ritual to survive as a sentient puddle. A tracker slips through cracks and smothers its quarry as it feeds.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, deafened, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands the languages it knew in its previous form but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Ambusher. In combat's first round, the tracker has advantage on attacks against creatures it surprised.
Damage Transfer. While the tracker grapples a creature, it takes half the damage dealt to it and the grappled creature takes the other half.
False Appearance. While the tracker sits motionless, a creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to distinguish it from a puddle.
Keen Tracker. The tracker makes Wisdom checks to track prey with advantage.
Liquid Form. The tracker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The tracker can traverse difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.
Watery Stealth. Underwater, the tracker makes Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide with advantage and can Hide as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Life Leech. Choose one Large or smaller creature the tracker can see within 5 ft. The creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, it is restrained, cannot breathe unless it can breathe water, and takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The tracker can grapple only one creature at a time.

statBlock.name: Spawn of Kyuss
statBlock.description: Green worms infest this walking corpse and jump onto nearby humanoids. A victim's soul remains trapped in the animated corpse and cannot be raised or resurrected until the spawn is destroyed.

sections.Languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the spawn regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is outside sunlight and running water. Acid, fire, or radiant damage prevents regeneration at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if its turn starts at 0 hit points and it fails to regenerate.
Worms. An effect that targets the spawn and cures disease or removes a curse kills its worms. The spawn loses Burrowing Worm.
Undead Nature. The spawn has no need for air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and use Burrowing Worm.
Burrowing Worm. Launch a worm at one humanoid the spawn can see within 10 ft. The worm latches onto its skin unless the humanoid succeeds on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. The worm is a Tiny undead with AC 6, 1 hit point, speed 1 ft., and 2 (-4) in every ability score. Before it burrows, the worm can be killed normally or scraped off with an action. The spawn can use that action to launch a scraped-off worm at a humanoid it can see within 10 ft. of the worm.
If still attached at the end of the target's next turn, the worm burrows into its skin and deals 1 piercing damage. At the end of each of that target's subsequent turns, it takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage per burrowed worm, up to a total of 10d6. An infested target dies upon reaching 0 hit points and rises 10 minutes later as a spawn of Kyuss. An effect targeting the victim that cures disease or removes a curse kills all the infesting worms.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

statBlock.name: Stone Giant Dreamwalker
statBlock.description: A stone giant lost in the dream it believes the surface world to be. It collects objects and creatures meaningful to it, attaching them to its stony body.

sections.Traits: Dreamwalker's Charm. An enemy that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the giant must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw unless the giant is incapacitated. On a failure it is charmed by the giant. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the charm on a success. Once it succeeds on the save, it is immune to this giant's Dreamwalker's Charm for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Petrifying Touch. Touch one Medium or smaller creature within 10 ft. that this giant has charmed. The creature must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be petrified. The giant can attach the petrified creature to its body. While attached to the living giant, the creature is unaffected by Greater Restoration or other magic that reverses petrification. If the giant is dead, such magic works normally, ending petrification and freeing the creature.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

statBlock.name: Storm Giant Quintessent
statBlock.description: A storm giant evades death by dispersing into a persistent storm. It can take giant form again to speak with visitors or defend its lair.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The giant can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Lightning Sword attacks or use Wind Javelin twice.
Lightning Sword. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 40 (9d6 + 9) lightning damage.
Wind Javelin. Choose one creature the giant can see within 600 ft. The giant throws a javelin of wind that counts as a magic weapon and strikes automatically for 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage. It disappears after hitting.
sections.Legendary actions:
The giant has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Spend the listed cost to use one option at the end of another creature's turn. The giant cannot use these actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them after completing its first turn.
Gust (1 action). Choose one creature the giant can see within 60 ft. A magical gust pushes it up to 20 ft. in a horizontal direction the giant chooses unless it succeeds on a DC 18 Strength saving throw.
Thunderbolt (2 actions). Choose one creature the giant can see within 600 ft. It takes 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, or half as much on a success.
One with the Storm (3 actions). The giant disperses into the storm around its lair. While dispersed, it can only take lair actions and cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, or other effects. It can end the effect at the start of any of its turns and reappear anywhere in its lair. It cannot disperse outside its lair or while another creature uses Control Weather or similar magic to calm the storm.
sections.Lair actions:
In giant or storm form, use one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. The giant cannot choose the same option two rounds in a row. It cannot use lair actions while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them after completing its first turn.
Thunderclap. Choose a point anywhere in the lair. Each creature within 20 ft. must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn.
Fog or Murk. Center a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog, or murky water underwater, on a point anywhere in the lair. It spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area. It lasts until the giant disperses it without using an action. Wind cannot disperse it.
Wind or Current. Create a 60-ft. line of strong wind, or a strong current underwater, that is 10 ft. wide and starts at a point anywhere in the lair. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 ft. in the direction of the gust. The gust disperses gas and vapor and extinguishes unprotected flames. Each protected flame has a 50 percent chance of going out.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or more effects around the lair.
High Wind. Within 1 mile, a fire can be lit only where it is sheltered from the wind.
Persistent Weather. Rain, snow, or blowing dust or sand persists within 1 mile, as appropriate for the region. Rain fills or overflows streams and rivers. Snow, dust, or sand accumulates in deep drifts or dunes.
Lightning and Thunder. Lightning flashes and thunder rolls day and night within 5 miles.
When the giant dies, lightning, thunder, and high wind cease immediately. Rain, snow, and blowing dust subside gradually within 1d8 days.
sections.Lair: A secluded place defined by the storm around it, such as a mountain peak, a waterfall, an island, a foggy lake, a reef, or a desert bluff.

statBlock.name: Swashbuckler
statBlock.classification: Medium humanoid (any race), any non-lawful alignment
statBlock.description: A charming duelist who courts fame and adventure and often makes a living as a pirate or corsair.

sections.Traits: Suave Defense. While wearing light armor or no armor and wielding no shield, the swashbuckler adds its Charisma modifier to AC.
sections.Bonus actions: Lightfooted. The swashbuckler can Dash or Disengage as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Dagger attack and two Rapier attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Tanarukk
statBlock.description: An orc transformed before birth by abyssal magic associated with Baphomet.

sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The tanarukk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the tanarukk's speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Greatsword attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
sections.Reactions: Unbridled Fury. When hit by a melee attack, make one melee weapon attack against the attacker with advantage.
